description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelGetLatestButton class, a custom widget for the SuiteCRM platform used specifically in the contracts module. It generates a UI button/link to retrieve the latest revision of a document when certain conditions are met.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelGetLatestButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetField, responsible for rendering a 'Get Latest Revision' button in subpanels for contracts.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space for header cells; used to render the header of the subpanel column.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the 'Get Latest' button/link based on the given layout definition, considering the contract's status and revision information.
